scope: Ordinary accepted XCCL with rank-process plus oneCCL-worker CPU/L3 affinity as one coherent candidate; no model throughput

hardware_contract.thread_receipt: Every rank records /proc/self/task thread names and Cpus_allowed_list after process-group initialization; candidate threads must remain inside the rank set and every arm must expose the expected singleton oneCCL worker CPU.

workload.control_affinity: rank process 0-31; explicit oneCCL worker list 31,30,29,28 preserves the runtime default worker CPU per local rank
workload.candidate_affinity: rank process uses eight logical CPUs/four physical cores per rank, split by the two L3 domains; explicit oneCCL worker list 19,23,27,31 keeps the worker inside its rank set

correctness_gate.analytic_sum: exact independently computed four-rank integer-valued BF16 SUM in every cycle
correctness_gate.protocol_receipt: Rt64_128_PCIE on every rank and no Rt64_PCIE

frozen_interpretation.both_pairs_pass: eligible for a separately frozen affinity-only endpoint arm; not yet a tok/s claim
frozen_interpretation.any_pair_fails: close affinity without a model load
frozen_interpretation.any_runtime_or_correctness_failure: reject and stop before the next arm
